svg.title: Boombox — portable stereo robot
svg.desc: A mustard robot whose body is a wide 1980s boombox with two speaker cones either side of a cassette window, a tuner strip and a row of keys, a carry handle arching over the top holding a small square head with two round eyes, a telescopic aerial, ring jointed arms with pincers, and short legs on flat feet.
